en: The Philippines was already inhabited by indigenous peoples long before Ferdinand Magellan arrived in 1521.
Emilio Aguinaldo was the first president of the Philippines, not Jose Rizal.
Ambrosio Rianzares Bautista authored the Philippine Declaration of Independence, not Andres Bonifacio.
No Philippine law officially declares Jose Rizal as the sole national hero, despite his widespread recognition.
The Sampaguita is the official national flower of the Philippines, not the Waling-waling.
The Philippine President serves a single six-year term without re-election, rather than multiple four-year terms.
The Philippines has over 180 distinct native languages, meaning Tagalog is not the only spoken language.
Fe del Mundo was the first Asian admitted to Harvard Medical School, not just the first Filipino female doctor.
The Sinulog festival primarily honors the Santo Niño, rather than celebrating the arrival of Ferdinand Magellan.
The Philippine legislative branch is a bicameral Congress composed of both the Senate and the House of Representatives.
The Indigenous Peoples' Rights Act legally protects ancestral domains, ensuring indigenous groups own their traditional lands.
Marcela Agoncillo and her daughters sewed the first Philippine flag, though Emilio Aguinaldo only designed it.
